patches.note: bgt cr7 -> nop: leave the frame limiter's sleep loop after one pass

speaker-count getter: lwz r3,0(r9) -> li r3,6. The global it reads starts at 2 and the audio-out setup sets it to 6 on another thread; a sound setup that read it first mixed the whole session in the 2ch layout (the menu music's varying centre/LFE). From the Resistance PC port by Psyykosis (MIT). RES_SPEAKERS=0 keeps the original read.
